structural_change: CX-IJ 10-18: the two-root ij leaf carries two 3:4 crossings inside one leaf (ijd_slot clk_s -> ipv / ipgb / ibad clk_q, and io_slot clk_q -> idl clk_s, 3 x 1,024 b), the defect that failed routes hbm_su_cx_dl_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -166.7 / FF -95.1) and hbm_su_cx_rc_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -173.4 / FF -77.9): related-clock STA times a 3:4 crossing at the VCO tick (setup 277.8 ps, coincident-edge hold) less the 150 / 100 distinct-entry reserve. Fix (dl/rc split, S81 x34 _s/_t precedent): one root per half; the crossings become 2-bank seams (static calendar windows >= 3 quanta for setup and rewrite-after-read), die-level 3:4 seam arcs. Lockstep vs the hub on Verilator 5.050 PASS QID 2 and QID 0 (checks=24183); mutants 1/2/3/4 FAIL. ij_q (serial, x1 per quarter): E seam to ij_s 2,114 b (5.6/um); the four slices port-5 data 4,096 b on W (inj_q0/1, 5.4/um), S (inj_q2, 4.9/um) and N (inj_q3, 4.9/um, clock/reset/fault at the NE end beside the ob seam banks). HH-1 10-18 regate: 388.8 x 388.8 -> 216 x 388.8 (gate 388.8^2: pin flops ring a 389 um square, TT / FF pin-flop spread 97.2 / 92.7 ps > 80, util 2.7%); the ring now spans 216 x 389 um. Variant u: unclustered TritonCTS H-tree over the pin-band sinks (qkd_d2d_static 10-15 precedent: sparse pin-band tile, unclustered tree 442..508 ps).
